headline: TURKEY'S FAILED STATE Coup RESULTS IN ARRESTS AND DISMISSALS
content: Around 6,000 people have been arrested following last Friday's failed coup attempt in Turkey, said Justice Minister Bekir Bozdag yesterday. So far about 2,839 detainees including dozens of generals were reported while more than 2,700 judges were dismissed.
